info.name: 📌 Amazon Bedrock API
info.description:
### About Amazon Bedrock

"The platform for building generative AI applications and agents at production scale."

AWS builds its own Amazon Nova models and, through Bedrock, hosts models from many other labs such as Anthropic, Meta, Mistral AI and DeepSeek. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Cloud platforms**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- AWS Account: [https://aws.amazon.com/console/](https://aws.amazon.com/console/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add these keys to your **Postman Vault** as `amazon_bedrock_access_key_id`, `amazon_bedrock_secret_access_key`, `amazon_bedrock_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using these exact names). Requests read them as `{{vault:amazon_bedrock_access_key_id}}` and so on, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/welcome.html](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/welcome.html)
    
- Models: [https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-supported.html](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/models-supported.html)

Large language models are trained on vast amounts of text data to generate human-like responses, while reasoning models are designed to draw logical conclusions and make decisions based on the information provided to them. Reasoning models go beyond simple text generation, using techniques like logical rules and probabilistic inference to arrive at a conclusion or solution. 
In two sentences, what is a knowledge graph, and how is it used in reasoning? 
A knowledge graph is a graphical representation of knowledge that stores entities, relationships, and concepts as nodes and edges, allowing for efficient querying and reasoning. In reasoning, knowledge graphs are used to provide a structured representation of the world, enabling models to draw inferences, make predictions, and answer complex questions by traversing the graph and applying logical rules. 
In two sentences, what is the role of attention mechanisms in transformer-based language models, and how do they contribute to the models' ability to reason? 
Attention mechanisms in transformer-based language models allow the model to focus on specific parts of the input sequence when generating a response, enabling it to selectively weigh the importance of different tokens and capture long-range dependencies. By doing so, attention mechanisms contribute to the model's ability to reason by facilitating the integration of relevant information from different parts of the input, and enabling the model to make more informed decisions. 
In two sentences, what is the difference between deductive and inductive reasoning, and how are they used in AI systems? 
Deductive reasoning involves drawing conclusions from certain premises using logical rules, whereas inductive reasoning involves making generalizations or drawing conclusions based on probabilistic patterns and observations. AI systems use deductive reasoning for tasks like theorem proving and rule-based expert systems, while inductive reasoning is used for tasks like machine learning and natural language processing. 
In two sentences, what is abductive reasoning, and how is it used in AI systems to make decisions under uncertainty? 
Abductive reasoning involves making educated guesses or hypotheses to explain a set of observations, and is used in AI systems to make decisions under uncertainty by generating plausible explanations for incomplete or ambiguous data. Abductive reasoning is particularly useful in situations where there is limited or noisy data, and the AI system needs to make a decision or take an action despite the uncertainty.
